title: Walicki Adam
name: Walicki Adam
description: guitarist and composer; b. 2 May 1976 in Warsaw. He studied with Piotr Lemański at the jazz department of the Fryderyk Chopin State Secondary Music School in Warsaw (1998-2000) and the jazz faculty of the Koninklijk Conservatorium Den Haag (the Netherlands, 2000-02). In 2005 he obtained a master’s degree from the Philosophy and Sociology Faculty of the University of Warsaw. In 2006, 2007 and 2009 he participated in courses of composition and sound engineering at the Institut Recherche et Coordination Acoustique/Musique at Centre Pompidou in Paris. updated in November 2015 (by Adam Walicki)
